member.name: T:DocumentModel.BaseTypes.Interfaces.ILengthValue
member.summary: Represents a length measurement that can be converted to various units (twips, points, millimeters, centimeters, inches).

member.name: P:DocumentModel.BaseTypes.Interfaces.ILengthValue.Value
member.summary: Raw value. The unit of this value is implementation-specific, but it is expected to be in a consistent base unit (e.g., twips) for internal calculations and conversions.

member.name: M:DocumentModel.BaseTypes.Interfaces.ILengthValue.ToTwips
member.summary: Value of the length in twips (1/20 of a point). This is the base unit for internal calculations.

member.name: M:DocumentModel.BaseTypes.Interfaces.ILengthValue.ToPT
member.summary: Value of the length in points (1/72 of an inch).

member.name: M:DocumentModel.BaseTypes.Interfaces.ILengthValue.ToMM
member.summary: Converts the current measurement to millimeters.

member.name: M:DocumentModel.BaseTypes.Interfaces.ILengthValue.ToCM
member.summary: Converts the current measurement to centimeters.

member.name: M:DocumentModel.BaseTypes.Interfaces.ILengthValue.ToInch
member.summary: Converts the current measurement to inches.

member.name: M:DocumentModel.BaseTypes.Interfaces.ILengthValue.ConvertTo(DocumentModel.BaseTypes.Interfaces.LengthUnit)

member.returns: The length value converted to the specified unit.
member.exception: Thrown if the specified unit is not supported.

member.name: M:DocumentModel.BaseTypes.Interfaces.ILengthValue.FromInch(System.Double)

member.summary: Converts a length value from the specified unit to an equivalent length measure.
member.remarks: Use this method to create an ILengthMeasure instance from a raw numeric value and its associated unit. Ensure that the provided unit is valid to avoid conversion errors.

The unit of the input length value, specified as a member of the LengthUnit enumeration.

member.name: M:DocumentModel.BaseTypes.Interfaces.ILengthValue.Parse(System.String)
member.summary: Parses a string representation of a length measure and returns the corresponding ILengthMeasure instance.
member.remarks: Use this method to convert user input or configuration values into a strongly typed length measure. The accepted string formats depend on the specific implementation of ILengthMeasure. If the input string is not in a valid format, an exception may be thrown.
member.param: The string that contains the length measure to parse. The format must be recognized by the implementation.
member.returns: An ILengthMeasure instance that represents the parsed length measure.

member.name: M:DocumentModel.BaseTypes.Interfaces.ILengthValue.TryParse(System.String,DocumentModel.BaseTypes.Interfaces.ILengthValue@)
member.summary: Attempts to convert the specified string representation of a length measure to its equivalent object, returning a value that indicates whether the conversion succeeded.
member.remarks: Use this method to safely parse user input or external data into a length measure without throwing an exception for invalid formats.
member.param: The string representation of the length measure to parse. This parameter cannot be null or empty.
When this method returns, contains the parsed length measure if the conversion succeeded; otherwise, contains the default value for the type.
member.returns: true if the value was converted successfully; otherwise, false.

member.name: M:DocumentModel.BaseTypes.Interfaces.ILengthValue.ToString
member.summary: Converts the current length measure to its string representation. Raw number formats are expected in InvariantCulture.

member.name: M:DocumentModel.BaseTypes.Interfaces.ILengthValue.ToString(System.IFormatProvider)
member.summary: Converts the current length measure to its string representation using the specified format provider. This allows for culture-specific formatting of the output string, such as using different decimal separators based on the culture settings provided by the formatProvider. If the formatProvider is null, the method should use invariant culture's formatting conventions.
member.param: An object that supplies culture-specific formatting information. If null, invariant culture's formatting conventions are used.
member.returns: A string representation of the current length measure, formatted according to the specified format provider.

member.name: M:DocumentModel.BaseTypes.Interfaces.ILengthValue.ToString(System.String,System.IFormatProvider)
member.summary: Converts the current length measure to its string representation using the specified format string and format provider. The format string can specify how the numeric value should be formatted (e.g., number of decimal places, unit symbols) while the format provider allows for culture-specific formatting. If the format string is null or empty, a default numeric format should be used. If the format provider is null, invariant culture's formatting conventions should be applied.
member.param: A standard or custom numeric format string. If null or empty, a default numeric format is used.
An object that supplies culture-specific formatting information. If null, invariant culture's formatting conventions are used.
member.returns: A string representation of the current length measure, formatted according to the specified format string and format provider.

member.returns: A string representation of the current instance, formatted according to the specified format string.

An object that supplies culture-specific formatting information. If null, the current culture is used.

member.name: T:DocumentModel.BaseTypes.Interfaces.IPercentValue
member.summary: Interface for percent value types, representing a value as a percentage (e.g., 50% as 0.5). This interface can be implemented by types that encapsulate percentage values and provide methods for conversion to and from percentage representations.
